verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS immigration and mobility platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions an SDK, client library, or developer API for the immigration product. The only developer-adjacent signals are an llms.txt file, which is not an SDK, and OpenAPI probes that all returned 404, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
